bibl.title: Kalila wa Dimna Manuscript
bibl.note: Arabic manuscript witness for textual comparison.

body.p:
I might have like for your conditions to be dire and for your end to be near. However, I have been beset by an evil
which does not make me delight at the precariousness of your situation nor your death,
and no one is more capable than I am of getting you out of this

situation. I am weary
of the mongoose and the owl: they are watching me, and I am weak and cannot fend them off. If you guarantee me restraint on your part
and ensure deliverance from the others who scare me and are watching me, I will save you from that in which you are and deliver you from
your bonds. Seize on that, and help me deliver you and myself;

p.n: The Cat Should Desire Common Rescue
